approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 game into a native build; players supply their own copy of the game.
notes: Steprant Android 1.8, based on freefrank/LostOdysseyRecomp v1.1.0. Qualcomm SGSR2 with SMAA in Quality, SGSR1, Vulkan optimizations, smoother frame pacing, audio fixes, TV/HDMI and advanced in-game diagnostics. Measurements are from one Xiaomi 14; thermals and battery gains require separate measurement. Players provide supported game data.
